text: Correction to claim f5cb3d33d9f2, which is append-only and stands unaltered. It asserted both mutations were killed but cited only TestRecordingAReviewDoesNotOverwriteTheMechanicalVerdict. That test calls RecordVerdict, which overwrites Reviewed before the assertions run, so it survives the FromReadingList-derives-Reviewed mutant; only TestSamplingLeavesTheSampleVerdictUnsetAndTheMechanicalVerdictIntact kills that one. ResolveCoverage requires only the listed evidence, so the record cleared while half its assertion was unsupported. Both tests are cited here.
